_meta.source_tree: vendor/TempleOS - TempleOS 5.03, cia-foundation mirror, commit c26482bb6ad3f80106d28504ec5db3c6a360732c
_meta.rule: Every entry was located by reading the cited file and line. verified=true means the signature below was copied from that line (plus its continuation lines) verbatim.
_meta.header_null_means: The function is a 'public' definition inside the Adam task and has no separate .HH / *Exts.HC declaration in the 5.03 tree; user tasks reach it through the task hash-table chain - see vendor/TempleOS/Doc/ScopingLinkage.DD:3 and vendor/TempleOS/Doc/GuideLines.DD:99-101. Every null in this field was re-checked one name at a time with grep -rEn "^[[:space:]]*(public )?(_)?(extern|import)[^;]*[ *]<Name>\(" --include=*.HC --include=*.HH vendor/TempleOS.
_meta.def_file_null_means: No HolyC body exists: the symbol is a compiler intrinsic (_intern) or is bound to an assembler label with _extern; the 'header' field then carries the only declaration.
_meta.verified_api_contract: A task JSON in data/tasks/ may set verified_api:true only if every API name it uses appears in this file with verified:true.

api.name: Print
api.note: A bare string statement compiles into a call to this exact function - vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/PrsExp.HC:402-408. Terry's own comment at StrPrint.HC:892 tells you to prefer the shortcut.

api.name: PutChars
api.note: A bare char-const statement compiles into a call to this - vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/PrsExp.HC:395-401. Up to 8 chars packed into one U64.

api.name: StrPrint
api.note: sprintf equivalent; caller supplies dst. MStrPrint() returns an MAlloc'ed string instead - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Print.DD:59.

api.name: StrPrintJoin
api.note: The vsprintf of HolyC: takes the built-in argc/argv of a '...' function. Used by Print, StrPrint, DocPrint, GrPrint.

api.name: MStrPrint
api.note: Returns an MAlloc'ed formatted string; must be Free()d.

api.name: StrLen
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_STRLEN). There is no HolyC or asm body; code is emitted by the back end - vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/OptPass789A.HC:905.

api.name: StrCmp
api.note: Assembler routine _STRCMP at StrA.HC:85, bound to the HolyC name by _extern at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/StrA.HC:308. Returns -1 / 0 / 1.

api.name: StrICmp
api.note: Case-insensitive StrCmp; binding declared at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/StrA.HC:310.

api.name: StrCpy
api.note: _extern _STRCPY; binding declared at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/StrA.HC:320.

api.name: StrFind
api.note: Substring search with flags. StrMatch / StrIMatch are the flagless asm variants - KernelC.HH:76 and :73.

api.name: StrNew
api.note: Heap copy of a string; Free() it.

api.name: LstSub
api.note: Nth entry of a double-NUL-terminated list, as used by the %z Print code - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Print.DD:48.

api.name: LstMatch
api.note: Index of needle in a double-NUL-terminated list, or -1.

api.name: MAlloc
api.note: Assembler routine _MALLOC at MAllocFree.HC:4 (it throws 'OutMem', MAllocFree.HC:5); HolyC binding declared at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/Mem/MAllocFree.HC:387. NULL mem_task = current task's heap.

api.name: CAlloc
api.note: MAlloc followed by MemSet to zero - MAllocFree.HC:397-398.

api.name: Free
api.note: Assembler routine _FREE at MAllocFree.HC:223; binding at MAllocFree.HC:383. Free(NULL) is explicitly legal - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/GuideLines.DD:57.

api.name: MSize
api.note: Real usable size of a heap object; large allocations are rounded up to a power of two - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:238.

api.name: MemCpy
api.note: Forward copy only - overlapping regions with dst>src corrupt. vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Quirks.DD:29.

api.name: MemSet
api.note: Byte fill. MemSetI64 / MemSetU16 / MemSetU32 fill wider units - KernelB.HH:172, :174, :176.

api.name: DocPrint
api.note: fprintf equivalent: print into a CDoc, then save it. Do not print partial DolDoc commands - DocPutS.HC:149.

api.name: DocNew
api.note: Create an empty in-memory DolDoc.

api.name: DocPut
api.note: The CDoc that a task's Print() output goes to; the field is Fs->put_doc, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3281. This is the hook point for a stdout-capture check.

api.name: DocClear
api.note: Use DocBottom then DocClear before switching a terminal to draw_it graphics - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Quirks.DD:19.

api.name: Sprite
api.note: Puts a sprite into the command-line DolDoc - GrSpritePlot.HC:469.

api.name: Ed
api.note: Takes a DolDoc link string, not merely a filename - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/CmdLineOverview.DD:17.

api.name: GrPlot
api.note: 2D, clipped, no transformation. Note the default argument is NOT last - legal in HolyC, vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:27.

api.name: GrPeek
api.note: Returns pixel colour, or -1 if off-screen or covered (GrPrimatives.HC:113). This is the primitive a framebuffer-hash check must use.

api.name: GrLine
api.signature: Bool GrLine(CDC *dc=gr.dc,I64 x1,I64 y1,I64 x2,I64 y2,I64 step=1,I64 start=0)
api.note: 2D, clipped, no transformation.

api.name: GrRect
api.signature: I64 GrRect(CDC *dc=gr.dc,I64 x,I64 y,I64 w,I64 h)
api.note: Filled rectangle given width and height, NOT x2/y2. Returns count of pixels changed.

api.name: GrCircle
api.signature: Bool GrCircle(CDC *dc=gr.dc,I64 cx,I64 cy,I64 radius,I64 step=1,F64 start_radians=0,F64 len_radians=2*pi)
api.note: Outline only, not filled. Read verbatim at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/Gr/GrPrimatives.HC:583-584: the last default is written as 2* followed by the single extended-ASCII byte 0xE3 (the pi glyph of the OS font), NOT the identifier pi. Both #defines resolve to the same F64 bit pattern - pi at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:50, the 0xE3 glyph at :51. The signature above substitutes pi so the JSON stays ASCII; portable source should write pi.

api.name: GrLine3
api.signature: Bool GrLine3(CDC *dc=gr.dc,I64 x1,I64 y1,I64 z1,I64 x2,I64 y2,I64 z2,I64 step=1,I64 start=0)
api.note: 3D with transformation and thickness (GrPrimatives.HC:772). Worked example: vendor/TempleOS/Demo/Graphics/Box.HC:12-23.

api.name: GrPrint
api.note: Text at pixel coordinates; a hand-written version is walked through in vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:90-95.

api.name: Sprite3
api.signature: U0 Sprite3(CDC *dc=gr.dc,I64 x,I64 y,I64 z,U8 *elems,Bool just_one_elem=FALSE)
api.note: Plot a Ctrl-R sprite blob into a CDC at x,y,z.

api.name: DCNew
api.note: Off-screen device context.

api.name: DCMat4x4Set
api.note: Installs the 4x4 transform used by GrLine3 and friends - see vendor/TempleOS/Demo/Graphics/Box.HC:11.

api.name: GrPaletteColorSet
api.note: Change one of the 16 palette entries; COLORS_NUM==16 at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:2931.

api.name: PaletteSetStd
api.note: Restores the stock palette - the safe undo for the gr_palette task.

api.name: GrUpdateTaskWin
api.note: NOT declared public - internal to the window manager. Task code should set Fs->draw_it and call Refresh() instead.

api.name: Snd
api.note: Starts or stops a square wave on the PC speaker via ports 0x43/0x42/0x61 (KMisc.HC:187-194). ona is a piano key number, 0 = rest - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Snd.DD:1.

api.name: Beep
api.note: Snd(ona); Sleep(500); Snd; Sleep(200) - it blocks the calling task for about 0.7 s (KMisc.HC:239-248).

api.name: Play
api.note: Note-string sequencer. The note grammar is documented in the function's own comment at ASnd.HC:206-235. A second identically named Play exists at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/Snd/SndMusic.HC:98, but Adam/Snd/MakeSnd.HC is never included by vendor/TempleOS/Adam/MakeAdam.HC, so that one is NOT loaded in 5.03.

api.name: Ona2Freq
api.note: Header declares (I64 ona), the definition takes (I8 ona) - a real header/definition mismatch that HolyC does not diagnose because it does no type checking.

api.name: Freq2Ona
api.note: 440.0 Hz is ona 60 - KMisc.HC:172.

api.name: Note2Ona
api.note: Middle C is ona=51, note=3, octave=4 - ASnd.HC:184.

api.name: Noise
api.note: Spawns a background task and returns immediately.

api.name: Sweep
api.note: Frequency sweep in a background task.

api.name: Spawn
api.note: target_cpu=-1 means the current CPU; parent=NULL means adam (KTask.HC:243-244). Pass the entry point as &Fun - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:55.

api.name: Yield
api.note: Assembler routine _YIELD at Sched.HC:156; HolyC binding declared at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/Sched.HC:284.

api.name: Sleep
api.note: Sleep(0) degenerates to Yield - KMisc.HC:157-158. Not a power-saving call (KMisc.HC:156).

api.name: JobQue
api.note: Multicore work queue; worked example with JobResGet at vendor/TempleOS/Demo/MagicPairs.HC:364-367.

api.name: Fs
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_FS) that reads the FS segment base - code emitted at vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/OptPass789A.HC:421-424. That is why Fs->x works with no parentheses.

api.name: Gs
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_GS). The CPU number of the current task is Fs->gs->num - CTask.gs at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3304, CCPU.num at KernelA.HH:3394.

api.name: PopUp
api.note: Spawns a pop-up task that JIT-compiles and runs the text in buf.

api.name: PopUpOk
api.note: Modal window with an OKAY button; wraps PopUp1() - DocPopUp.HC:149.

api.name: PopUpPickLst
api.note: lst is a double-NUL-terminated list; returns the chosen index. Declared - extern I64 PopUpPickLst(U8 *lst); at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/DolDoc/DocExt.HC:13.

api.name: Refresh
api.note: Waits for cnt screen refreshes - the correct way to pace an animation loop.

api.name: SettingsPush
api.note: Saves terminal/window settings so a graphical demo can restore them; paired with SettingsPop - see vendor/TempleOS/Demo/Graphics/Box.HC:30,47. Declared at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/AExts.HC:81. The saved snapshot is class CTaskSettings, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3197-3213.

api.name: SettingsPop
api.note: Declared at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/AExts.HC:80.

api.name: GetKey
api.note: Blocks for MSG_KEY_DOWN, returns the ASCII value and sets the scan code - Message.HC:143-144.

api.name: ScanKey
api.note: Non-blocking: returns FALSE immediately if no key is waiting - Message.HC:124.

api.name: GetChar
api.note: Like GetKey but waits for a key that has a non-zero ASCII value, and echoes by default - Message.HC:183.

api.name: ScanChar
api.note: Non-blocking char poll - the idiom used by the graphics demos' main loop, vendor/TempleOS/Demo/Graphics/Box.HC:33.

api.name: GetStr
api.note: Returns an MAlloc'ed string; Free() it - see vendor/TempleOS/Demo/Define.HC:25,31.

api.name: ms
api.note: Global mouse state. The class is CMsStateGlbls - there is no CMouseStateGlbls in the tree.

api.name: Dir
api.note: IMPORTANT: the definition at DskDirB.HC:102 has NO defaults - it reads 'I64 Dir(U8 *files_find_mask,Bool full)'. The defaults that make 'Dir;' legal exist only in the header at KernelC.HH:283.

api.name: Cd
api.note: A Cd() must be followed by two semicolons when a #include follows it - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Quirks.DD:31, and see vendor/TempleOS/Adam/MakeAdam.HC:1.

api.name: DirMk
api.note: Cd(name,TRUE) can also create directories - DskDirB.HC:163.

api.name: Copy
api.note: If the destination name ends in .Z the copy is stored compressed; otherwise uncompressed - ADskA.HC:63-65.

api.name: Move
api.note: Implemented as Copy followed by Del - ADskA.HC:96-97. Not atomic.

api.name: FileRead
api.note: Reads the whole file into an MAlloc'ed buffer. Free() the result.

api.name: FileWrite
api.note: Writes the whole file.

api.name: FileFind
api.note: The right primitive for a sys_state 'does this file exist' check.

api.name: Find
api.note: Plain substring search over files - no regular expressions (Find.HC:148). Usage example: vendor/TempleOS/Doc/CmdLineOverview.DD:38.

api.name: CompressBuf
api.note: Counterpart is ExpandBuf, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelC.HH:121. There is no function called Compress or Uncompress in 5.03.

api.name: D
api.note: Hex dump showing offsets - KDbg.HC:173.

api.name: Dm
api.note: Exactly D(addr,cnt,FALSE) - KDbg.HC:206: shows absolute addresses instead of offsets.

api.name: Dbg
api.note: Panic(msg,msg_num,FALSE) - enters the debugger without declaring a panic (KDbg.HC:650-651).

api.name: Uf
api.note: UNASSEMBLES a named function (ADbg.HC:255) - it prints disassembly and code size, NOT source text. To read source use Man() or E().

api.name: Man
api.note: 'Owner's manual for symbol. Edit src code for symbol' - FunSeg.HC:347. THIS is the 'open the source of Dir' call, not Uf.

api.name: E
api.note: Edit the source line that produced the code at a given address - FunSeg.HC:333.

api.name: ClassRep
api.note: Reflection dump of a record using the compiler's own class info (ADbg.HC:163). The class_name default uses the lastclass keyword - see vendor/TempleOS/Demo/LastClass.HC:31.

api.name: FunRep
api.note: Names, register/stack slots and values of a function's local vars - ADbg.HC:220.

api.name: Who
api.note: Lists the symbols in a task's hash table - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/GuideLines.DD:103.

api.name: Option
api.note: Sets a compiler option bit on the CURRENT CCmpCtrl (Fs->last_cc->opts, CMisc.HC:3). The public declaration is hand-written in StartOS.HC before any header is loaded, using the internal type names I8i/I64i. GetOption is at vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/CompilerB.HH:18.

api.name: StreamPrint
api.note: Injects text into the source stream being compiled; only legal inside an #exe{} block - CMisc.HC:69,78. Worked example: vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KMain.HC:40-45.

api.name: ExeFile
api.note: Literally builds the string '#include "<name>";' and JIT-executes it - CMain.HC:617-619. This is the proof that #include IS 'run this file'.

api.name: ExePrint
api.note: Compile-and-run a formatted string; returns the value of the last executed expression - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Print.DD:80.

api.name: ExeCmdLine
api.note: The terminal's JIT-compile-and-execute loop: each statement is compiled to machine code and Call()ed immediately - KTask.HC:339-347. This is why HolyC needs no main().

api.name: throw
api.note: A plain function, not a statement. ch is a multi-char constant of at most 8 chars (KExcept.HC:85); read it in catch{} as Fs->except_ch - vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3322.

api.name: PutExcept
api.note: Ready-made catch{} body that reports the exception code and the caller chain - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:230.

api.name: Break
api.note: Sends <CTRL-ALT-c> to the current task - KExcept.HC:118.

api.name: Now
api.note: CDate is a 64-bit fixed-point datetime; print with %D and %T - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Print.DD:44,46.

api.name: tS
api.note: Seconds since boot, as F64. Called with no parens: F64 t0=tS;  - see vendor/TempleOS/Demo/MagicPairs.HC:340.

api.name: tM
api.note: Seconds, corrected to stay in sync with the music subsystem - ASnd.HC:108.

api.name: Sqrt
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_SQRT).

api.name: Abs
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_ABS); it is the F64 absolute value.

api.name: Sin
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_SIN), backed by x87.

api.name: Cos
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_COS).

api.name: Pow
api.note: Assembler _POW at KMathA.HC:514. The HolyC-level equivalent is the backtick operator base`power - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:190.

api.name: SqrI64
api.note: Integer square; Sqr() is the F64 version at KernelB.HH:106.

api.name: ToI64
api.note: Truncating F64 to I64 conversion; preferred over multiplying by 1.0 - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:57.

api.name: ToBool
api.note: Forces a value to exactly 0 or 1 - needed because Bool is only a signed byte, vendor/TempleOS/Doc/GuideLines.DD:79.

api.name: RandU16
api.note: Per-task linear-congruential generator over Fs->rand_seed - KMathB.HC:89.

api.name: Rand
api.note: The header comment reads 'With timestamp' - KernelC.HH:547.

api.name: Seed
api.note: Sets the per-task seed - required to make a randomised task check deterministic.

api.name: OutU8
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_OUT_U8). Real usage: vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KMisc.HC:187-194.

api.name: InU8
api.note: Compiler intrinsic (_intern IC_IN_U8).

api.name: Sprite3B
api.note: Same as Sprite3 but the x,y,z translation is applied AFTER the transformation: it sets dc->x/y/z plus DCF_TRANSFORMATION, calls Sprite3(dc,0,0,0,elems) and restores the flags - GrSpritePlot.HC:247-253.

api.name: Sprite3Mat4x4B
api.note: Plot a sprite rotated by an explicit 4x4 fixed-point matrix.

api.name: DocSprite
api.note: Puts a sprite into a CDoc instead of a CDC - the document-side output path for task dd_sprite.

api.name: MsSet
api.signature: U0 MsSet(I64 x=I64_MAX,I64 y=I64_MAX,I64 z=I64_MAX,I64 l=I64_MAX,I64 r=I64_MAX)
api.note: Sets the mouse position/buttons programmatically and generates a message (Mouse.HC:43). This is how task in_mouse can be driven deterministically in CI.

api.name: DocSave
api.note: Serialises a CDoc to a raw MAlloc'ed buffer: text part first, NUL, then one serialised CDocBin header (num,flags,size,use_cnt) plus size bytes per binary block - DocFile.HC:153-164. Also declared as an import in vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KExts.HC:9.

api.name: DocWrite
api.note: Writes the doc back to its file (uses DocSave internally, DocFile.HC:180). It has NO declaration anywhere in the tree - it is NOT part of the alphabetical DocBottom..DocTop block at vendor/TempleOS/Adam/AExts.HC:14-40.

api.name: DocLoad
api.note: Inverse of DocSave: reads the text part, then walks the trailing CDocBin blocks - DocFile.HC:10-26.

api.name: DocForm
api.note: Editable form generated from a class via compiler reflection; class_name defaults to the lastclass keyword.

api.name: Mat4x4IdentEqu
api.note: Lives in GrDC.HC, NOT in GrMath.HC. Fixed-point identity matrix.

api.name: Mat4x4RotX
api.note: In the source the parameter is not named 'angle': it is the single extended-ASCII byte 0xE8 - identifiers may contain bytes 128-255, see vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/Lex.HC:470.

api.name: Mat4x4RotY
api.note: In the source the parameter is the single extended-ASCII byte 0xEA, not 'angle'.

api.name: Mat4x4RotZ
api.note: In the source the parameter is the single extended-ASCII byte 0xE9, not 'angle'.

not_found.name: Compress
not_found.reality: No such function in 5.03. The buffer API is CompressBuf (vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/Compress.HC:281) with ExpandBuf (vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelC.HH:121). File-level compression is selected by naming the file *.Z - vendor/TempleOS/Adam/ABlkDev/ADskA.HC:63-65.

not_found.name: Uncompress
not_found.reality: No such function. Use ExpandBuf, or just FileRead a .Z file - decompression is transparent.

not_found.name: GrPoke
not_found.reality: Does not exist. Write with GrPlot (vendor/TempleOS/Adam/Gr/GrPrimatives.HC:51), read with GrPeek (:111).

not_found.name: CTask.core_num
not_found.reality: No such field anywhere in the tree. The CPU of a task is Fs->gs->num: CTask.gs at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3304, CCPU.num at KernelA.HH:3394. The name cpu_num does occur (20 lines), but never in CTask: as a class member only in CMPCrash (vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:3813) and CMeshEdTri (vendor/TempleOS/Adam/Gr/SpriteMesh.HC:31); elsewhere it is an argument or local name - vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/MultiProc.HC:76,132, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelC.HH:629, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KExts.HC:77, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:283, vendor/TempleOS/Adam/Opt/Utils/Profiler.HC:27.

not_found.name: CMouseStateGlbls
not_found.searched: grep -rn 'CMouseStateGlbls' vendor/TempleOS  (zero hits); grep -n 'CMouseStateGlbls|MouseState' docs/TZ_v0.1.md  (zero hits)
not_found.reality: Not present in the OS tree. The real class is CMsStateGlbls - vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelA.HH:2998 - and the global is ms, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KernelC.HH:616. NOTE: docs/TZ_v0.1.md never names a mouse-globals class either; its [VERIFY] markers at docs/TZ_v0.1.md:77 and :737 ask only about the global 'ms', which is correct. This row records a name that exists in neither document, so it must not be reported as a spec error.

not_found.name: main
not_found.searched: grep for a main() entry point convention
not_found.reality: HolyC has no main(). Any code outside a function runs at load time, in order - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:59, mechanism at vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/KTask.HC:339-347.

not_found.name: continue
not_found.reality: Not a keyword. Use goto - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:234.

not_found.name: typedef
not_found.reality: Not a keyword. Use class - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:216.

not_found.name: ?: (ternary operator)
not_found.reality: Absent from the operator table; stated explicitly at vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:192.

not_found.name: F32 / float
not_found.reality: There is no 4-byte float type. F64 only - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/HolyC.DD:19.

not_found.name: @ scope operator
not_found.searched: vendor/TempleOS/Compiler/Lex.HC:462-471, vendor/TempleOS/Kernel/StrA.HC:330-338, grep for '@' in HolyC expression position
not_found.reality: Not a language feature in 5.03. '@' is simply an ordinary identifier character (its bit is set in char_bmp_alpha_numeric, StrA.HC:330-333) so that asm-local labels can be written @@05:. CCF_KEEP_AT_SIGN (KernelA.HH:2148) makes the lexer emit '@' as a token, but nothing in the 5.03 tree ever sets that flag. A separate, unrelated use of '@' is the alias marker at the start of a Define-list entry - vendor/TempleOS/Doc/Define.DD:3.
